en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Abdullah Bin Bahr, from Hareyz who said,
‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The one with sexual impurity massages (with oil), then washes’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No’.
en.sarwar: 6. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from ‘Abd Allah ibn Bahr from Hariz who has said the following:
“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘Can one after experiencing sexual relation, rub oil, then take Ghusl (bath). He (the Imam) said, ‘No, (it is not permissible).”’
